faqs.a:
The minutes or a summary of action of a meeting of the city council or any board or
               commission of the city shall be promptly recorded, and such records shall be open
               to public inspection provided that the minutes of meetings of the personnel merit
               appeals board and the building code advisory board not open to the public in accordance
               with provisions of this article shall not be open to public inspection.
(Code 1960, § 2-3.5(d); Code 1981, § 2-1)
State Law reference—
Public meetings, C.R.S. § 24-6-401 et seq.
